## What’s new

- **Shape your workspace:** Drag the dividers to resize the category list and task preview. Briefly resting the pointer on a divider highlights every affected border, the feedback remains visible throughout the drag, and sidebar or preview sizes stay within usable limits as the terminal changes.
- **Focused dialogs:** Centered dialogs now dim the workspace beneath them so confirmations, editors, help, settings, and other overlays hold visual focus.

Release-managed installations can update with `/update`. Cargo-managed installations should run:

```sh
cargo install --locked mach-tui
```

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Q1CHENL/mach/compare/v0.10.1...v0.11.0
